note: Template for python -m scripts.verify_fund_nav_identity_v2. Pinned to Light main aeb5933754f46af997198a0ab82c14e108a4553a (merge of PR #166). Before a strict audit OPS must confirm, live, that the deployed Light revision, the builder request/policy and the Stage-1 quotas are still these; otherwise re-pin light_revision, cohort_query/parameters and stage1_quotas and record the change. The quotas are the previously observed 30-fund request and are valid only if request/policy/deploy are equal. active_ceiling is the parent-supplied structural daily potential (a ceiling, never a target, never auto-raised). A non-zero structural_baseline delta must be explained and then acknowledged via accepted_structural_delta. margin_fraction is a contract constant (exactly "1/10"); any other value is rejected.

sec.rationale: Required positive integer: A8 is NOT_EVALUATED (strict audit blocked) when absent/null, and FAIL when fund_classes_latest_mv max(synced_at) is in the future or older than this many days relative to the audit capture timestamp. 7 days is a conservative bound pending OPS confirmation of the SEC class sync cadence; a larger value must be justified and recorded, never raised to make A8 pass.

builder.quota_provenance: observed Stage-1 slots alternatives=6 equity=8 fixed_income=14 thematic=2; the caller at aeb59337 backend/app/services/portfolio_builder.py:3590-3594 uses _regime_selection_slots(min_slots=1), not the default 2. Re-pin from the real request before use.
builder.cohort_query_provenance: mirrors backend/app/optimizer/data.py select_universe_funds catalog quality gates at aeb59337 (unchanged from a3e21f40: MIN_UNIVERSE_AUM_USD=200000000, strategy_label <> 'Unclassified', LEFT JOIN fund_risk_latest_mv nav_quality_ok NULL/TRUE, fund_nav_coverage_mv n_obs >= MIN_COMMON_OBS=400 and first_nav <= today - MIN_UNIVERSE_HISTORY_DAYS=1095, full-history window). A7 measures pre-readiness potential: the aeb59337 current-readiness join (fund_nav_readiness_current_v1 READY) is deliberately NOT applied. Request-specific funds_catalog filters are NOT included and must be added when the pinned request uses them. The verifier wraps this SELECT server-side with an outer LIMIT 100001 and reads it through a server-side cursor.
builder.cohort_query: SELECT f.instrument_id, f.strategy_label FROM public.funds_profile_mv f LEFT JOIN public.fund_risk_latest_mv r ON r.instrument_id = f.instrument_id JOIN public.fund_nav_coverage_mv c ON c.instrument_id = f.instrument_id WHERE f.aum_usd IS NOT NULL AND f.aum_usd >= %(min_aum_usd)s AND f.strategy_label <> 'Unclassified' AND (r.nav_quality_ok IS NULL OR r.nav_quality_ok IS TRUE) AND c.n_obs >= %(min_obs)s AND c.first_nav <= current_date - %(history_days)s::int ORDER BY f.instrument_id LIMIT 100001
